gui.napoleonic_line.title: Line Infantry
gui.napoleonic_line.category.tooltip: Command musket line infantry formations and volley fire
gui.napoleonic_line.shoulder_arms.toolti: Move muskets and arquebuses to left shoulder. Recruits hold fire and march in formation
gui.napoleonic_line.present_arms.tooltip: Take muskets and arquebuses into the main hand at the ready without firing
gui.napoleonic_line.volley.tooltip: Aim with the crosshair. The rank turns to face it and fires along that line, a fraction of a second apart.
gui.napoleonic_line.fire_at_will.tooltip: Independently acquire targets, fire, and reload
gui.napoleonic_line.reload.tooltip: Force all unloaded musketeers and arquebusiers to reload (about 18s, a little faster or slower per man). No cartridges are spent.
gui.napoleonic_line.cease_fire.tooltip: Leave the line order. Arquebuses keep the mod's reload, damage, and gunshot.
msg.napoleonic_line.volley_aiming: Aim volley target point (LMB — Fire, RMB/Esc — Cancel)
msg.napoleonic_line.volley_no_ready: No loaded musketeers with line of sight in the selected group!
msg.napoleonic_line.cease_fire: Group [%s]: at ease. Arquebuses keep the mod's shot.
death.attack.musket_ball: %1$s was struck down by a musket ball
